title: Optimal User-Level Private Stochastic Convex Optimization and Mean Estimation with Heavy Tails
abstract: arXiv:2611.28460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed stochastic gradients under $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-user-level differential privacy, which protects each user's entire collection of samples. Instead of assuming a uniformly bounded Lipschitz constant, we only assume bounds on the second- and $k$-th moments of the random sample Lipschitz parameters. This allows for unbounded, heavy-tailed stochastic gradient distributions and can lead to sharper excess risk bounds. We characterize the minimax optimal excess population risk up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm achieves the optimal rate with only $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ users. As a byproduct of our algorithmic developments, we obtain tight bounds for user-level private mean estimation under norm-moment assumptions, improving over the guarantees of Esfandiari et al. (2022) and Zhao et al. (2024). Finally, for mean estimation under the directional-moment assumption of Agarwa

translated_title: 重尾条件下的最优用户级隐私随机凸优化与均值估计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$ 用户级差分隐私下具有重尾随机梯度的随机凸优化问题，该隐私机制保护每个用户的全部样本集合。与假设一致有界的 Lipschitz 常数不同，我们仅假设随机样本 Lipschitz 参数的二阶矩与 $k$ 阶矩有界。这一较弱的假设允许无界的、重尾的随机梯度分布，并能带来更紧的过剩风险界。我们在对数因子范围内刻画了极小极大最优的总体过剩风险。我们的算法仅需 $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon)$ 个用户即可达到最优速率。作为算法发展的副产品，我们在范数矩假设下获得了用户级隐私均值估计的紧致界，改进了 Esfandiari 等人（2022）和 Zhao 等人（2024）的结果。最后，对于在方向矩假设（Agarwal 等人）下的均值估计问题（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文在用户级差分隐私下仅假设随机样本 Lipschitz 参数的矩有界（而非一致有界），从而支持重尾随机梯度分布，刻画了随机凸优化的极小极大最优过剩风险，并作为副产品得到了改进的用户级隐私均值估计紧致界。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the minimax optimal excess risk for user-level differentially private stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed gradients under only moment assumptions on random Lipschitz parameters, and as a byproduct derives improved tight bounds for user-level private mean estimation.
